combos.explanation: Creature deaths create Treasure, Chatterfang also creates Squirrels, and Chatterfang can sacrifice those Squirrels to continue the engine.
Either life-loss or life-gain trigger starts a mandatory loop that drains opponents.
Conscripts untaps Kiki-Jiki and each new hasty Conscripts copy repeats the loop.
Blinking Peregrine Drake repeatedly untaps more lands than the blink activation costs.
With Ballista given lifelink and enough counters, damage gains life and Heliod replaces the removed counter.
Deathtouch makes each point of Sharpshooter damage lethal and creature deaths untap it.
